message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libbpf && python3 - <<'PY'
import struct, subprocess, tempfile, os, textwrap, pathlib
BTF_MAGIC=0xeB9F; BTF_VERSION=1
btf=struct.pack('<HBBIIIIII', BTF_MAGIC, BTF_VERSION, 0, 24, 0, 4, 4, 4, 0)+b'\x00\x00\x00\x00'
ext=struct.pack('<HBBIIIIII', BTF_MAGIC, BTF_VERSION, 0, 32, 0,0, 0,0, 0)+struct.pack('<I',8)+struct.pack('<II',0,1)
open('/tmp/btf.bin','wb').write(btf)
open('/tmp/ext.bin','wb').write(ext)
print('wrote',len(btf),len(ext))
PY
clang -c -x c /dev/null -o /tmp/empty.o && objcopy --add-section .BTF=/tmp/btf.bin --add-section .BTF.ext=/tmp/ext.bin /tmp/empty.o /tmp/test.o && readelf -S /tmp/test.o | grep BTF && ./bpf-object-fuzzer /tmp/test.o >/tmp/out 2>&1; ec=$?; echo EXIT:$ec; cat /tmp/out | head -50
